title: Classic Sidecar Tour of San Francisco
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Welcome to the most side-splitting San Francisco adventure! Buckle up for a classic sidecar ride, where you'll feel like a superhero with the wind in your hair. It's a duo delight - one person's in the sidecar, feeling like a VIP, while the other's behind the pilot, plotting world domination (or just selfies).
We'll hit all the hotspots! ,Lombard Street, where even cars question their driving skills. Next, we'll zip through Chinatown, where the fortune cookies write back! Hold on tight as we cross the majestic Golden Gate Bridge. It's so iconic; even pigeons strut on it.
In between laughs, we'll pause at the Painted Ladies, where houses compete in a beauty pageant. The hills are alive with the sound of tourists yelling "Whee!"Pro tip: Don't forget to tip your driver, the comedic genius behind the wheel. If you're not laughing, you might be napping, and that's just unacceptable!
So join us on this sidesplitting city tour. 
Now remember when you see the price, they take 25% fees!
